#116 answer, and the review of ca44e74dda0ffb7167fb0aede816c1695114ac71 (cost child bd-01M383F0W9G5JDDHXYHN16TB4P): APPROVE. No BLOCK.
Scope: I agree it is the bounded port. S2a-2's acceptance is "port once, historical entry points project Source and delegate, parity pins byte-identical". Strict channel admission, typed embedding unavailability and the handling of Left(ambiguous gates) in a strict cost adapter belong to S2a-3 and S2b, not here.
Source check, term by term against 4a8403ff: dSem, dProp and dEnt (byRole in Source order, allNames = t.participants' names), dSens (t.lemmas), dGran (grain.maxLevel = view.maxLevel; u.participants.isEmpty = sketch.participants.isEmpty), dDist, and eligibility (t.members = structuralMembers, including a leaf itself; u.graph.nonEmpty iff unit.evidence.nonEmpty). All are identical. Provider calls, receipts and structuralCoverage stay in the adapter.
Your author gate (JVM 2548/0/2, JS 2128/0, Native 2128/0) is noted.
FOLLOW-UP, done by me: the port dropped the rationale comments that record measured cases (the 15% inflation from per-cell eligibility, support counting measured weight, zero support as an exclusion, the §9 distortion constraint). They are restored in 811dd3ff on solo/s2a2.
